parse_Problem_from_txt: parse a geometry problem from a text string into a Problem object with clauses and goal
load_Problem_from_file: load multiple geometry problems from a text file into a list or dictionary of Problem objects
load_Theorem_from_file: load deduction rules from a text file into a list or dictionary of Theorem objects
load_Definition_from_file: load construction definitions from a text file into a list or dictionary of Definition objects
compute_Dependency_why_me: compute the dependency chain explaining why a geometric predicate holds using why_me on a Dependency object
